summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its London Stock Exchange Total Voting Rights and Capital announcement under the UK's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules (the US analogue of an Exchange Act ownership-threshold notice). As of 30 October 2026 the company reports 7,918,049,933 ordinary shares in issue with voting rights, 177,875,932 treasury shares, and total voting rights of 31,674,132,292, plus small preference share classes. No transaction, stake, price, advisor or board recommendation is stated; the disclosure is purely administrative, enabling shareholders to calculate DTR notification obligations. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
